newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin's wife also taken to hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin's wife also taken to hospital.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin's wife, Naina, has fallen ill and joined her husband in hospital, the Kremlin said on Monday

Presidential spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing that Naina Yeltsin, 64, had been taken to the Central Clinical Hospital (TsKB) in Moscow where her husband is being treated for pneumonia.
Yastrzhembsky said she had an infection. He gave no other details but, making clear the illness was not grave, said she was able to see her husband regularly.
"Naina Iosifovna is in the TsKB. She was taken to hospital -- she is a bit better now -- with an infection and visits Boris Nikolayevich several times a day," he said.
Mrs Yeltsin also had a brief spell in the Central Clinical Hospital last August, when she had a kidney operation.

Russia is in the grips of an influenza epidemic. Finance Minister Alexander Livshits, 50, was also taken to the Central Clinical Hospital last Wednesday with flu. A ministry spokesman said Livshits was still in the hospital.
